model_policy: Evaluate only the already fitted trial 0.1.0. No model selection, refit, calibration, feature changes or TEST-based normalization.
primary_metrics: unweighted mean of three room MAEs
secondary_metrics: pooled MAE/RMSE/R2 explicitly distinguished from macro room metrics
baseline: TRAIN-only target mean conditional on candidate angle, frozen before test feature inference; descriptive baseline only, not another learned candidate.
tolerance_status: Reuse middle exploratory tolerance scenarios from v3. Not an engineering standard, overall accuracy, or pass/fail criterion.
data_policy: Predict all TEST feature rows, save and hash predictions, then load TEST numeric targets for scoring. Keep all zero and extreme values. Fail on missing/non-finite/duplicate or incomplete rows; no imputation or exclusions.
scope: First frozen-model assessment of three previously excluded room target sets in the same building/weather simulation. Not a new building/year or measured-field validation. Prior feature-only coverage audit and representative-room selection history remain limitations.
future_use: After this evaluation, these three rooms are observed holdout data. Any subsequent method choice informed by their results cannot use them again as an untouched final test. They remain excluded from training in this task.
